projects.title: Prishtina in the Making
projects.description:
We have been continuously supporting Prishtina Municipality's activities and events throughout the years, creating brands and designing various materials for various events. Our desire is to help make our city better, and the following is a collection of pro-bono work we produced.

Mobile Market

We created a brand for the Prishtina Mobile Market, a recent Prishtina Municipality activity in support of local producers coming from the rural area of the town. 

The market moves to different neighbourhoods around Prishtina, making its products available for all citizens.
